lines.trans: Are you stalking me? Good Lord! What are you doing here?
Waiting for Katya. That is the last thing I needed.
Turn around right now.
Listen, I cannot go on like this anymore.
Everything between Katya and me is falling apart because of you.
Let us tell her the truth.
Boy, you ruined your relationship yourself.
Now you want to ruin things between Katya and me too?
No, it is just... You will never tell Katya about what happened.
She is coming.
What do we do?
Do not let her into the bathroom.

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'вернуться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'turn around / look away', paired with 'отворачиваться'.

examples.trans: He turned away from the window.

examples.text: Друзья не отвернулись от него в беде.
examples.trans: Friends did not turn away from him in trouble.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ейчас').

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
